name: loopseed
description: Let a project vision guide autonomous work, or choose independently verified One-Shotted delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Give Codex a vision or a concrete outcome to deliver.
interface.longDescription: LoopSeed lets the agent discover what to improve, try it in the real product and revise its judgment from experience. A continuing vision can resume in Codex. A bounded request ends when the outcome works. Choose One-Shotted when the deliverable needs a formal evidence-backed receipt.
defaultPrompt: $loopseed 让玩家打完第一局，就想再开一局。
$loopseed Fix the hand disappearing after a saved game is loaded.
$loopseed one-shotted Deliver a playable slice with independently verified acceptance.
